content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was related to the handling of connection errors in the S3A proxy tests after an upgrade of httpclient/httpcore. The tests were failing because the expected error messages from the `AmazonClientException` were not matching the actual error messages, specifically the references to the proxy connection rejections. The patch modifies the test assertions to simplify error handling, effectively allowing any connection error to be considered acceptable rather than checking for specific messages that may have changed due to the library upgrade.
